summary: Verizon ABS II LLC, as depositor for Verizon Master Trust, filed an 8-K reporting an underwriting agreement dated September 15, 2026 with BofA Securities, SMBC Nikko, Truist Securities and U.S. Bancorp Investments for a $999,999,000 Series 2026-3 asset-backed note issuance. Classes include $826,008,000 A-1a, $65,000,000 A-1b, $68,120,000 B and $40,872,000 C notes, expected to close September 22, 2026. An indenture with U.S. Bank Trust and an account control agreement with U.S. Bank National Association will be executed at closing. This is a routine securitization shelf takedown, not a special situation; monitor closing mechanics and any spread talk.
